imports.title: Vehicle import
imports.description: Upload an Excel file, validate rows, then commit a clean import.
imports.availabilityHint: Imported vehicles start in the "announced" state. Check each one in (Check-in workflow) to add it to the pool and make it available for loan.
imports.templateHint: Required columns: category, manufacturer, model. Optional: internal_number (auto-generated when blank), serial_number, license_plate, current_odometer_km, current_operating_hours, current_location, supplier, notes. Common German headers (Kategorie, Hersteller, Modell, Kennzeichen, Kilometerstand, Betriebsstunden, Standort, Notizen) are recognized; any column you leave out stays blank. Unknown or blank categories are placed in the "Sonstiges" category.
